Prices change with every trade; the [live Kalshi market](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtruthsocial/number-of-trump-truth-social-posts-this-week/kxtruthsocial-26oct03) is the current figure.

## What is our view?

We have no model of our own for this market, so the odds above are the traders' consensus and not an independent estimate. For calibration: in our sample of settled Politics markets, the Kalshi mid-price a day before close scored a Brier error of 0.0809 (a coin-flip price scores 0.25; lower is better).

## How does this market resolve?

> If the number of Truth Social posts by Donald Trump from Sep 27, 2026 to Oct 3, 2026 is below 80, then the market resolves to Yes.

Close: October 4, 2026 at 13:59 UTC. Expected settlement: October 4, 2026 at 14:00 UTC. Settlement source: [Roll Call](https://rollcall.com/factbase/trump/topic/social/?platform=truth+social&sort=date&sort_order=desc&page=1). Full terms: [Kalshi contract terms](https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/POLITICALSTAT.pdf).

## What could move the odds?

- New polling, official announcements or filings, and statements by the named officials.
- The publication schedule of the named poll or tracker.
- A rules clarification or settlement-source change published by Kalshi on the market page.
- Order-book depth: thin books move on small orders, so a large price move on little volume says little.

## How reliable are markets like this one?

Across 119 settled Politics markets in our sample (Kalshi, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-03), the Kalshi mid-price about 24 hours before close had a Brier error of 0.0809; a coin-flip price scores 0.25 and lower is better. Contracts quoted at 5 cents or less settled YES 4.9% of the time (41 markets); contracts quoted at 95 cents or more settled YES 100.0% (8 markets). The sample covers a few weeks, so it is a guide to how markets like this have behaved, not a guarantee of how this one will settle.

How this is resolved

The observation period begins at 12:00 AM ET on Sep 27, 2026 and ends at 11:59 PM ET on Oct 3, 2026.
The primary resolution source for this market is Roll Call.
In the event that Roll Call data is unavailable or inaccurate, alternative sources may be used at Kalshi's discretion.
The post count will be recorded at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 4, 2026.

Payout criteria

Truths, ReTruths, and Quote Truths are included in the total count.
Replies are included if captured by Roll Call.
"Between" is inclusive of the lower and upper bound.

Doesn’t count for payout: Posts deleted as of the Expiration Time.
